title: Library Visits Rise as Funding Stalls
text:
A recent report from the city council shows that the public library attracted more visitors last year than at any time in the past decade. Researchers counted over 400,000 visits, an increase of nearly twelve percent compared with the previous year. The council attributes this growth to longer opening hours and a wider range of free workshops for children and adults.

However, the report also notes that funding for new books has remained unchanged since 2019. Librarians warn that the collection is ageing and that many popular titles are often unavailable. The council has promised to review the budget next spring, although no specific amount has been announced.

questions.text: According to the report, by how much did library visits increase compared with the previous year?
According to paragraph two, since when has funding for new books stayed the same?
What can be inferred about the library's collection from paragraph two?
options: It has been moved to a new building
It is only available to children

questions.text: Why might the council's promise to review the budget be considered uncertain?
options: No specific amount has been announced
The report was rejected by the public

paragraph_translations: Um relatório recente do conselho municipal mostra que a biblioteca pública atraiu mais visitantes no ano passado do que em qualquer momento da última década. Os pesquisadores contabilizaram mais de 400.000 visitas, um aumento de quase doze por cento em relação ao ano anterior. O conselho atribui esse crescimento ao horário de funcionamento mais longo e a uma gama mais ampla de oficinas gratuitas para crianças e adultos.

No entanto, o relatório também observa que o financiamento para novos livros permanece inalterado desde 2019. Os bibliotecários alertam que o acervo está envelhecendo e que muitos títulos populares costumam estar indisponíveis. O conselho prometeu revisar o orçamento na próxima primavera, embora nenhum valor específico tenha sido anunciado.
